mapper.select: select * from safety_bpm_model ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by create_time desc

select * from ( select bm.id, bm.model_id, bm.is_show, bm.model_name, bm.form_id, bm.form_name, sp.perm_url form_url, bm.template_id, bm.template_type, bm.model_type, bm.create_time, bm.creator, bm.sys_id, bm.form_detail, bm.perm_id from safety_bpm_model bm inner join safety_sys_perm sp on bm.perm_id=sp.id )tb ${ew.customSqlSegment} order by create_time desc

select distinct sp.id from safety_sys_user_role sur inner join safety_sys_role_perm srp on sur.role_id=srp.role_id inner join safety_sys_perm sp on srp.perm_id=sp.id where sur.del_flag=0 and sp.delete_falg='0' and process_display=1 and sur.user_id=#{userId}

select distinct sp.id from safety_sys_user_role sur inner join safety_sys_role_perm srp on sur.role_id=srp.role_id inner join safety_sys_perm sp on srp.perm_id=sp.id where sur.del_flag=0 and sp.delete_falg='0' and process_display=1 and sur.role_code=#{roleCode}
